title: Format detection — check query params, not just file extension
trigger: Detecting media/subtitle format from a URL where the file extension is absent or ambiguous
principle: Format detection by file extension alone fails for URLs that have no file extension — common with API endpoints that encode format in query params (`?fmt=vtt`, `?format=srt`, `?output=ass`). The extension check is the fast path (no URL parsing, unambiguous for `.vtt`/`.ass` files), but a query-param fallback is required for extension-less URLs. Order: extension (fast, unambiguous) → query param (fallback for APIs) → default.

cases.context: API endpoint URL has no file extension — format encoded in query param; extension-only detection falls back to wrong default parser

applyFor: Media type detection from API URLs (no extension, format in query)
Any format/type inference from URL where extension-only check fails
API endpoints that encode output format in query params instead of file extension
